DEFINE.core_strategy: Enforce a lifecycle state machine on the workspace: transitions an 'open' session to 'closed' which immutably freezes card operations and unlocks a read-only data extraction interface.

rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: Increases complexity of data retention policies and risks accidental loss of finalized decision data.
Breaks the immutability guarantee required by external agents for reliable integration.

dependencies.description: Database support for session status updates and retrieval queries.

assumptions.description: The session status check is sufficient to secure data retrieval.
assumptions.how_checked: Test API endpoint retrieval requests against sessions with status 'open' versus 'closed'.
assumptions.if_false: re-evaluate auth requirements for session retrieval.

risks.description: Race condition between session closing and an in-flight card mutation.
risks.impact: A card could be edited or moved exactly as the session is closed.
risks.mitigation: Database transaction locks at the session status check point.

DEFINE.thesis: The quadra session lifecycle will be extended to a 'closed' state to provide a secure boundary for finalized decision data retrieval by external agents.

goals.why: Participants need to finalize decisions and lock workspaces.
goals.success_metric: 100% of 'closed' sessions successfully block further card mutations.

goals.description: Enable secure, restricted retrieval of finalized session data.
goals.why: External agents require finalized results without data leakage during active sessions.
goals.success_metric: 100% of retrieval requests for 'open' sessions return 409 Conflict.

success_criteria.criterion: Mutations to a 'closed' session are rejected.
success_criteria.measurement: Integration tests running against the session service.
success_criteria.baseline: Session status field is ignored by the system.

non_goals.description: Building a user-facing dashboard for browsing closed sessions.
non_goals.tradeoff: This feature is outside the scope of quadra's role as an ephemeral workspace orchestrator.

walkthrough.name: Closing an active session
with_strategy: Session status updates to 'closed' in database.
Canvas disables card editing tools for all participants.
API retrieval now succeeds for external agents.
